newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 29.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - President Henri Konan Bedie returns home from European tour. - Privatisation Committee relaunches sale of agro-industrial giant Palmindustrie's central maintenance and new project workshops; deadline for offers, which are open to any nationality, is January 20; earlier tender operation failed to attract sufficient interest. LA VOIE - Supreme Court confirms two-year jail sentences imposed on three La Voie journalists convicted of insulting head of state Bedie. Abou Drahamane Sangare, Freedom Neruda and Emmanuel Kore are about halfway through their sentences. LE JOUR - Ivorian power generating company Ciprel imports new generating gas-fired turbine for its power station at Vridi on the outskirts of Abidjan - Renovation work on Abidjan's Felix Houphouet-Boigny stadium to begin in December as part of major programme launched by sports ministry; stadium likely to be closed for at least nine months. Other stadiums and sport grounds will also be renovated.
